// Default button surface
@use 'sass:color';

$primary: #007bff !default;
$name: 'primary';

@mixin surface($pad: 8px 16px) {
  padding: $pad;
  border: 0;
}

.button-#{$name} {
  @include surface;
  color: #fff;
  background: $primary;

  /* Hover darkens the fill */
  &:hover {
    background: color.adjust($primary, $lightness: -10%);
  }
}
